1938, March & April
Page 38 Mar. 30 Madeline Miller of Monroe, Extremely nervous - dreaming about sucide .....
Apr. 1 (Baby) Pat. Shea - 4 - in Kiefers with scarlet fever and threatened mastoid.
1 Christine Wuestwald - 43 - Lutheran - Colitis - in hospital (Ford) 2 week without help. Enrolls To-day 50c
1 Mrs. B. Kusmurz - 42 - thinks she is possessed - fearful headaches ... can't sleep or eat. Husband disgusted, wants divorce ...
2 Mrs. M. Garofalo - 51 - Ulcers of stomach 16 yrs. has invalid hus- band and 8 children. ...
Regis McGuirk - 40 - belongs to a law firm in Detroit; now in Mayo Br. Hosp. - twitching of head continually - neck sore from - wife non- Cath. has 3 children.
Mary Kliz - 52 - nerve.
Edgar Laperierre - wayward
5 Robert Mahoney - 16 - going blind. One eye lost. Other almost sight- less - oldest of three whose mother died 6 yrs. ago.
Page 39
April 5 August Dettloff - 73 - dropsey and gangreenous diabetis one leg ampu- tated last week (29) Now threatened with loss of the other. . . . Thank God, however has come back to confession and Com. after 40 yrs .-
Ralph Jacoboice - 29 of Gr. Apids - strep infection - ostemolitis - four transfusion, etc. inrolled % phone To-day ... by Mother ..... promises frequent Communion.
